name: Sexton 2024 Lanadelumab HAE Plasma Kallikrein-Kinin QSP
description: Full runtime translation of the Sexton 2024 hereditary angioedema plasma kallikrein-kinin system model for lanadelumab. The model uses the public supplementary R/C source code: 61 states, 82 base biochemical parameters, sampled virtual-patient PK and acute-attack forcing, and SC 150 mg q2w dosing.
